caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic jug with a wide, rounded body, a narrow neck, and a slightly flared rim. The jug has two small loop handles at the neck. The surface of the jug is textured and features a combination of tan, brown, and gray tones, with blue decorative elements near the top, including abstract floral or wave-like patterns below the rim. The upper front of the jug near the rim bears an inscription in uppercase letters that reads: "C. CROLIUS MANUFACTURER MANHATTAN-WELL NEW YORK." The jug displays some uneven coloration and blotchy spots, particularly on the lower half, with a significant dent on its right side. The composition of the drawing is centered, and the background is plain and uncolored, emphasizing the vessel. The artist's signature, "Chas. Caseau," appears in the lower left corner.
title: Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
